title: Sam of the Spanish Main
content: It's a terrible habit, and I'm not proud of it. But sometimes while sketching at a restaurant I turn my friends into notorious outlaws."You made me look horrible," my perfectly nice-looking and generous pal said when he saw the sketch."But it's not you, it's a pirate relative of yours."-----Related posts:Dave as a film noir detectiveStewart as a zombieCornwell's Illustration Buddies as Gangsters
